dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's Ploy's. She always forgets things!
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈplɔɪz. ʃiː ˈɔːlweɪz fərˈɡɛts ˈθɪŋz!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And whose belt is this? Is it yours?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈhuːz ˈbɛlt ɪz ˈðɪs? ɪz ɪt ˈjʊrz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, it isn't mine. My belt is brown. Is it yours?
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ɪt ˈɪzənt ˈmaɪn. maɪ ˈbɛlt ɪz ˈbraʊn. ɪz ɪt ˈjʊrz?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No, it isn't. Maybe it's Fah's.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ɪt ˈɪzənt. ˈmeɪbi ɪts ˈfɑːz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I think it's hers. She has a black belt.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈθɪŋk ɪts ˈhɜːrz. ʃiː ˈhæz ə ˈblæk ˈbɛlt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK. I'll give Ploy her scarf in class tomorrow.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. aɪl ˈɡɪv ˈplɔɪ hɜːr ˈskɑːrf ɪn ˈklæs təˈmɑːroʊ.
